name: 89106 · Las Vegas, NV
findings: ZIP 89106 (Las Vegas) has 184 nonprofit organizations. 69 of them (38%) list at least one way to get involved on their websites: membership, volunteering, public events, or civic and political action.
The most common is membership, listed by 54 organizations.
Religious organizations are the largest group offering opportunities (25% of those with an identified type).
Compared with 10 similar places, ZIP 89106 (Las Vegas) has more organizations offering opportunities per resident.

observations.title: More organizations list public events
observations.text: Per resident, more organizations in ZIP 89106 (Las Vegas) list public events on their websites than in 10 similar places (about 2.2 times the typical level).

confidence.text: Based on 43 organizations here; 34% of all organizations here have no identified type.

observations.question: Why are public events so common here? Who takes part, and who might not be reached?
